form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Mrs. Feinstein (for herself, Ms. Klobuchar, and Mr. Blumenthal) introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation

form.official-title: To amend the Federal Trade Commission Act to eliminate the common carrier exemption for telecommunications companies.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Protection from Robocalling Act of 2019.

paragraph.text: illegal robocalls and spam calls are a growing annoyance and problem for the people of the United States; and
exemptions within the Federal Trade Commission Act (15 U.S.C. 41 et seq.) limit the enforcement capabilities of the Federal Trade Commission with respect to illegal robocalling and spam calling.

section.header: Eliminating the common carrier exemption for telecommunications companies
section.text: Section 4 of the Federal Trade Commission Act (15 U.S.C. 44) is amended by striking the Act entitled An Act to regulate commerce, approved February 14, 1887, and all Acts amendatory thereof and supplementary thereto and the Communications Act of 1934 and inserting subtitle IV of title 49, United States Code,.
